يحتقب (form VIII)
# يَحْتَقِبُ (yaḥtaqibu) /jaħ.ta.qi.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
# يُحْتَقَبُ (yuḥtaqabu) /juħ.ta.qa.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
# يَحْتَقِبَ (yaḥtaqiba) /jaħ.ta.qi.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
# يُح
